title: Installed programs
whyItMatters: The installed program list reveals software that may still hold accounts or licenses and needs a separate sign-out or transfer step.
source: Windows uninstall registry keys in HKLM and HKCU Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall, both 32- and 64-bit views
notes: Provider reads both registry views and both hives. Install date, publisher and scope come from uninstall entries; no program files are opened.

cleanup.signOut: Sign out of and deactivate the programs that hold accounts or licences before you uninstall them, so seats and cloud data stay with you.
steps: Read the list in the plan and pick the programs this PC no longer needs.
Sign out of and deactivate each of those programs, and copy out any data stored inside them.
Uninstall them from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
cleanup.risk: Uninstalling can remove local data, sign-in sessions and licence seats. Some programs leave settings and folders behind.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, Uninstall or remove apps and programs in Windows: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/apps/uninstall-or-remove-apps-and-programs-in-windows
